actions-list.actionItem: Pursuant to the order of yesterday, the Journal of the proceedings of the Senate was deemed approved to date.
Pursuant to the order of yesterday, the morning hour being deemed expired, and the times for the recognition of the two leaders being reserved.
The following transactions of morning business occurred on today.

H.R. 5334 (Rep. Panetta):
        A bill to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to allow early childhood educators to take the educator expense deduction, and for other purposes.

        -- Cloture on the motion to proceed to the measure invoked in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 86 - 12. Record Vote Number: 212

PN1092:
        Walter Clayton, of New York, to be Director of National Intelligence

        -- Considered by Senate.

        -- Confirmed by the Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 51 - 47. Record Vote Number: 211
Under the authority of the order of today, at  8:12 p.m, the Presiding Officer (Ms. Lummis in the chair) declared the Senate adjourned, under its order of today, until 10:30 a.m. tomorrow.
